{{nihongo|'''Aomi Shrine'''|青海神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Echigo Province]].

'''Aomi Shrine''' (あおみじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Kamo, Niigata|Q857293|qid=Q857293}}, {{ill|Niigata Prefecture|Q132705|qid=Q132705}}. The surrounding area forms {{ill|Kamoyama Park|Q68013407|qid=Q68013407}}.

=== History ===
The shrine was founded in {{ill|726|Q23555|qid=Q23555}} ({{ill|Jinki (era)|Q1373210|qid=Q1373210}} 3). Its origin dates to when the Aomi chiefs, who developed the local Aomi-go area, established a shrine to enshrine various deities beginning with their ancestral god, {{ill|Saonetsuhiko|Q11120574|qid=Q11120574|lt=Shiine-tsuhiko no Mikoto}}<ref name="当社">[https://www.aomi-jinjya.or.jp/history/yuisyo.html Historical Chronology] Aomi Shrine</ref><ref name="散歩">Editorial Committee for Historical Walks of Niigata Prefecture, ed., *Historical Walks of Niigata Prefecture (Historical Walks 15)*, Yamakawa Shuppansha, 2009, pp. 126–127</ref>.

Between the worship hall and the shrine office is a {{ill|Nightingale floor|az|Bülbül döşəmə|de|Nachtigallenboden|fr|Plancher rossignol|ja|鶯張り|pl|Słowicza podłoga|zh|夜鶯地板|qid=Q1471563}} {{ill|Hallway|ar|ممر (عمارة)|bar|Flez|be|Калідор|be_x_old|Калідор|bg|Коридор|ca|Passadís|cs|Chodba|cv|Коридор|de|Flez|eo|Koridoro|et|Koridor|eu|Korridore|fi|Käytävä|fr|Couloir (architecture)|gl|Andadeiro|hr|Hodnik|hu|Folyosó|id|Lorong|it|Corridoio|ja|廊下|ko|복도|lt|Koridorius|mk|Ходник|ms|Koridor|olo|Pertiväli|pl|Hol (architektura)|pt|Corredor|ru|Коридор|sh|Hodnik|simple|Corridor|sq|Japia|sw|Ushoroba|tr|Koridor|uk|Коридор|vi|Hành lang|zh|廊|qid=Q1135449}}. === Cultural properties ===
*Aomi Shrine precinct sutra mound excavated artifacts (Designated Cultural Property of Niigata Prefecture, designated March 29, 1962)<ref name="県">[https://www.pref.niigata.lg.jp/uploaded/life/472403_1189603_misc.pdf List of Designated Cultural Properties, etc.] Niigata Prefecture</ref>
*Aomi Shrine buildings (Designated Cultural Property of Kamo City, designated January 12, 1975)<ref name="市1">[https://www.city.kamo.niigata.jp/docs/30129.html Aomi Shrine buildings] Kamo City</ref>
*Furukawa family documents (Designated Cultural Property of Kamo City, designated January 12, 1975)<ref name="市2">[https://www.city.kamo.niigata.jp/docs/30130.html Furukawa family documents] Kamo City</ref>
*Site of the zelkova tree planted by an imperial envoy (Designated Historic Site of Kamo City, designated January 12, 1975)<ref name="市3">[https://www.city.kamo.niigata.jp/docs/30136.html Site of the zelkova tree planted by an imperial envoy] Kamo City</ref>
*Okina Cedar (Designated Natural Monument of Kamo City, designated January 12, 1975)<ref name="市4">[https://www.city.kamo.niigata.jp/docs/30137.html Okina Cedar] Kamo City</ref>

=== Access ===
